notes:
FEATURES
• Open local PDF files page by page in the redactor.
• Keep separate boxes, rules, and confirmation for each PDF page.
• Save the current page as a page-specific PNG and record source_page in the coordinate log.

ENHANCEMENTS
• Navigate with PREV / NEXT, PAGE n / N, and PageUp / PageDown.
• Render PDF pages locally at 200 DPI with a 40 million-pixel safety cap.
• Show clear errors for corrupt, password-protected, and oversized PDFs.
• Add PDF support to the landing page, user guides, privacy text, and third-party notices.

FIXES
• Ask once before discarding unsaved PDF or folder markings.
• Ship complete PDFium license text without unexpanded include directives.

OPTIMIZATIONS
• Bundle PDFium directly; no Ghostscript, Poppler, or external PDF tool is required.

NOTES
• The Windows build is an unsigned preview; Linux and macOS builds remain untested.
• PDF text extraction, PDF output, password entry, and folder-mode PDFs are not included.
